STS2_CHARLOTTE_EPOCH_1.title: A New Report
STS2_CHARLOTTE_EPOCH_1.description:
After a certain president of Spina di Rosula explored it, news of the open Spire quickly spread throughout Fontaine.
As a journalist of The Steambird, Charlotte smelled a headline in the making.
“Then let's set off! We're going to be the first paper with a finished story!”
STS2_CHARLOTTE_EPOCH_1.unlockText: Unlock: Charlotte becomes a playable character.
STS2_CHARLOTTE_EPOCH_1.unlock: Charlotte has arrived at the Spire.
STS2_CHARLOTTE_EPOCH_2.title: A Fresh Perspective
STS2_CHARLOTTE_EPOCH_2.description:
Charlotte discovered many rare treasures she had never seen before. But as a journalist rather than an adventurer, what she cared about were the stories behind the Spire.
Naturally, “interviews” with the ancient ones were an indispensable part of that.
All kinds of interview notes filled her notebook. “Looks like I've found plenty of news this time too!”
STS2_CHARLOTTE_EPOCH_3.title: An Exclusive Scoop
STS2_CHARLOTTE_EPOCH_3.description:
The Spire always brings more stories — sometimes Charlotte needs days just to sort out a single expedition.
Though the climb is perilous, that great whale called Neow at the foot of the tower always brings her back.
How curious! She couldn't help wondering about the Spire's master.
STS2_CHARLOTTE_EPOCH_4.title: An Exclusive Interview
STS2_CHARLOTTE_EPOCH_4.description:
At the very top of the Spire, Charlotte met the tower's master — the Architect.
She eagerly took out her notebook and camera, ready to interview the mysterious figure. But he seemed to dislike the idea, and sent her back to the bottom.
What an odd man. Still, an interview with someone like that would be an absolute exclusive!
STS2_CHARLOTTE_EPOCH_4.unlockInfo: Win an Ascension 1 run as Charlotte.
